summary.text: JJ DeFeo is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Laurence Miner.
DeFeo is a university student who has worked as a federal policy intern and a union community organizer, and his stated platform centers on replacing property taxes with a land value tax.

paragraphs.text: JJ DeFeo graduated from Sanborn Regional High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he served as the at-large student representative on his school board while in high school, and that he is studying political theory and constitutional democracy, physics, and philosophy of science at university.

He said that in 2025 he was a policy intern on the Manufacturing USA team at the National Institute of Standards and Technology and then worked as a union community organizer for the AFL-CIO, and that he has also worked for several political campaigns.
DeFeo advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, receiving 365 votes.

In the survey he listed three key messages: ending property taxes without adopting an income or sales tax by switching to an offset land value tax, moving to a form of proportional representation for the legislature, and lowering rent and mortgage costs.
